name: The Bear Cave
summary: The Bear Cave is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 17: The Guarantee Has No Date. Argued in Part 17 (The lease is already debt).

mentions.excerpt: The Bear Cave relayed on September 27, 2026 Michael Burry's tally of nearly $1.2 trillion of such leases plus more than $1.5 trillion of purchase commitments, a wider instrument; Burry wrote on September 19 that vehicles, guarantees and backstops could lift the total above $3 trillion.

sides.claim: The relayed Bank OZK argument holds that the weakest construction projects must find genuine buyers or long-term lenders before sponsor support and property values fail.
